title: leptinella traillii subsp. pulchella
intro: Leptinella traillii subsp. pulchella, commonly known as the green and gold, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is native to New Zealand and is valued for its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Leptinella traillii subsp. pulchella are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cellular damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, although further research is needed to fully understand its medicinal properties.
